sources.articleTitle: Philippines wins first Eurovision Song Contest Asia
Philippines’ Carmelle wins first Eurovision contest in Asia

headline: Philippines Wins The Inaugural Eurovision Song Contest Asia Title
seoTitle: Philippines Wins First Eurovision Asia Contest
metaDescription: Carmelle Collado from the Philippines secured victory at the inaugural Eurovision Song Contest Asia held in Bangkok with her song Sobra-Sobra.
aiSummaryBullets: The inaugural Eurovision Song Contest Asia took place at the One Bangkok Forum in Thailand.
Carmelle Collado claimed the title representing the Philippines with her entry, the song Sobra-Sobra.
Eleven nations participated in the event, marking the first time the contest was held outside of Europe.
aiContextParagraph: The Eurovision Song Contest Asia represents a regional expansion of the long-standing international song competition typically held in Europe. The first edition of this contest was hosted in Bangkok, Thailand, at the One Bangkok Forum. Eleven different nations participated in the grand final, marking a significant departure from the competition's traditional European scope. The event concluded with the victory of the Filipino representative, 19-year-old Carmelle Collado. Her winning entry, a song titled Sobra-Sobra, features a blend of pop and rap elements and is described as an anthem centered on women's empowerment. This transition of the Eurovision brand into the Asian market signifies the contest's broader efforts to localize its format globally, with the Bangkok stage serving as the inaugural venue for this regional adaptation of the popular musical competition.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained traction due to the historic nature of the first Eurovision event held outside of Europe, with 51/100 viral activity.
